Lateral Grid Lines
Enable grid lines to the left and right.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the left back and right front.

Longitudinal Grid Lines
Enable grid lines to the front and back.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the right back and left front.

Erase Room Cells
Erases room cells from the current story of the design.

Room Mode - Draw
Current mode draws rooms into the cells of the grid. Existing room cells are replaced when drawn upon.
Press this button to change drawing modes for the room buttons.
%1 Draw mode draws new room cells and replaces existing room cells.
%1 Change Room Type mode changes the type of existing rooms.

Room Mode - Change Room Type
Current mode changes the type of rooms that are clicked. The room type cannot change if this would create two rooms of the same type with the same room number on the same story.
Press this button to change drawing modes for the room buttons.
%1 Draw mode draws new room cells and replaces existing room cells.
%1 Change Room Type mode changes the type of existing rooms.

Room Mode - Unknown
Current mode is an unknown mode.
Press this button to change drawing modes for the room buttons.
%1 Draw mode draws new room cells and replaces existing room cells.
%1 Change Room Type mode changes the type of existing rooms.

Lateral Grid Lines
Enable grid lines on the beam.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the port quarter.

Longitudinal Grid Lines
Enable grid lines fore and aft.

Diagonal Grid Lines
Enable diagonal grid lines to the starboard quarter.

Erase Room Cells
Erases room cells from the current deck of the design.

Room Mode - Change Room Type
Current mode changes the type of rooms that are clicked. The room type cannot change if this would create two rooms of the same type with the same room number on the same deck.
Press this button to change drawing modes for the room buttons.
%1 Draw mode draws new room cells and replaces existing room cells.
%1 Change Room Type mode changes the type of existing rooms.

- Room identifier distinguishes between different rooms of the same type on the same story. To make two bedrooms on the same story, change the room id before painting the second bedroom. Room id can be the same on different stories. e.g. Story 1 can have bedroom 4 and story 2 can also have bedroom 4.

- Room identifier distinguishes between different rooms of the same type on the same deck. To make two staterooms on the same deck, change the room id before painting the second stateroom. Room id can be the same on different decks. e.g. Deck 1 can have stateroom 4 and deck 2 can also have stateroom 4.

Increase Room Number
Increases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same story.

Decrease Room Number
Decreases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same story.

Room Number
Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same story.

Push this button to change the room number of an existing room to the number shown. The room number cannot change if this would create two rooms of the same type with the same room number on the same story.

Increase Room Number
Increases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Decrease Room Number
Decreases the room number. Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Room Number
Room number is used to distinguish between rooms of the same type on the same deck.

Push this button to change the room number of an existing room to the number shown. The room number cannot change if this would create two rooms of the same type with the same room number on the same deck.
